title: Top Chiropractic - Videos
description:
Welcome to Top Chiropractic, the UK’s first dedicated Upper Cervical Chiropractic clinic!

We understand that the spine and the nervous system are closely related, and issues can occur in the spine that can impact the function of the nervous system- known as vertebral subluxations. This occur when the body is unable to adapt to the stress that it is under, and it can happen in situations such as sports injuries, prolonged postures, mental stress, to name but a few. 

In our clinics, located in London, Birmingham, Newcastle and Edinburgh, we proudly serve a wide range of individuals in a welcoming environment, delivering tailored, data-driven care to help our community enhance their body’s innate ability to heal and function optimally. Many people choose this form of care to support a wide range of health concerns, such as neck pain, migraines, tinnitus, Meniere’s and dizziness. 

Subscribe to our channel to learn more about chiropractic care and our team.
